questions.q: Which browser dev tools panel shows every request a page makes, including API calls?
questions.explanation: The Network panel is the closest thing dev tools has to a wire tap — it shows every HTTP request the page makes, including timing, headers, status codes, and full response bodies. It's indispensable for debugging API calls and slow page loads.

questions.q: What is the first recommended step before trying to fix a bug?
choices: Change several things at once to save time
Rewrite the whole file from scratch
questions.explanation: If you can't reproduce a bug reliably, you can't know when you've actually fixed it. Reproduction first forces you to understand the exact conditions that trigger the problem — which usually reveals the cause before you've written a single fix.

questions.q: How should regular expressions generally be treated?
choices: As a tool to reach for automatically for any text matching
As a tool used deliberately, tested live, and documented clearly
questions.explanation: Regex is powerful but notoriously hard to read after the fact. Best practice: use it when it genuinely saves complexity over a plain string method, test it interactively (as this lesson's widget lets you do), and leave a comment explaining what pattern it matches.
